title: E-Bike (Pedelec) Rental
description: Borrow an e-bike from AStA for getting around campus and the surrounding area. Great for trips into Birkenfeld or Idar-Oberstein.
tip: ID required as deposit. First-come first-served.

title: Deutschlandsemesterticket
description: Your semester fee includes the Deutschlandsemesterticket — free travel on all regional trains and buses across Germany. Activate it via the student portal.
tip: Show your digital student ID in the DB Navigator app.

title: KADU Campus Pub
description: Student-run campus bar operated by AStA since 2023. Affordable drinks, relaxed atmosphere, occasional events like bingo, karaoke and quiz nights.
tip: Spontaneous events happen — follow AStA on Instagram for announcements.

title: Tea Room
description: A cosy student lounge in the communications building. A quiet spot to relax between lectures, have tea, and meet people.

title: Culinaria Campus Restaurant
description: Main campus cafeteria serving hot meals Monday to Friday. Monday is always Vegan Day — 100% plant-based menu. Uses regional and seasonal ingredients where possible.
tip: Vegan Monday — the full menu is plant-based every Monday. Check the Mensa tab for this week's menu.

title: Sports Hall & Facilities
description: Full sports hall, athletics field, tennis court, basketball court, and beach volleyball court — all on campus. Free for enrolled students.
schedule: See Events & Sports for scheduled activities

title: Fitness Room
description: Free weights and cardio equipment available for students. Managed by AStA.
schedule: During designated hours — check AStA notice board

title: Art Room
description: Creative studio space managed by AStA. Available for student art projects, painting, and creative work.

title: Band / Music Room
description: Practice room with instruments for student bands and musicians. Book via AStA.

title: Billiard Room
description: Relax with a game of billiards between lectures. Managed by AStA, free for students.

title: Campus Library
description: Full academic library with study spaces, printing, and digital resources. Access journal databases, borrow textbooks, and use quiet study rooms.
schedule: Mon–Fri 08:00–20:00 (term time), shorter hours during breaks

title: Writing Workshop (Schreibwerkstatt)
description: Free academic writing support — from structuring your thesis to improving scientific German. Individual coaching and group sessions available.

title: Green Office
description: Student-run sustainability bureau founded in 2017. Organises vegan breakfasts, clothing swaps, film nights, electronics drives, and community cleanups. Open to all — earn POA points for regular involvement.
tip: You can earn POA (extracurricular) points by participating in Green Office projects.

title: Green Office Events
description: Regular events: 🌱 Vegan Breakfasts — free plant-based breakfast on campus. 👕 Clothing Swap Parties — bring clothes, take clothes. 🎬 Eco Film Nights. 🔌 Electronics Collection (with NABU). 🧹 Community Cleanup Days.
tip: Follow @greenoffice_ucb on Instagram for event announcements.

title: International Students Network (ISO)
description: Community network for UCB's ~1,800 international students from 80+ countries. Social events, buddy system, and mutual support for navigating life in Germany.

title: International Office
description: Official support for international students — visa questions, enrollment documents, recognition of foreign qualifications, and general guidance on studying in Germany.
schedule: Office hours — see ucb website for current times

title: Psychosocial Counseling
description: Free and confidential counseling for students dealing with stress, anxiety, loneliness, or academic pressure. No judgment, no appointment needed for a first conversation.
schedule: Consultation hours — check with student services

title: AStA — Student Union
description: Your elected student representative body. Manages KADU, fitness room, bike rental, art room and more. Advocates for student interests. Visit them for any campus-related question.
schedule: Regular office hours — see AStA notice board
